title: Sometimes AAPS loose synchronisation with BYODA and  remains 20/30min late
symptom: AAPS sometimes loses synchronization with BYODA and remains 20/30 minutes late on BG value shown in overview, and can be worse for latest loop run. It can be 10min, 15min, sometimes 50min or more late. It started with room update (dev, 3.0, 3.1) and never occurred on v2.8.2 and earlier.
evidence_quote: Sometimes (not always), when I use my phone (web browser, phone call...) I can loose the synchro, and aaps is 10min, 15min, but it can sometimes be 50min or more late on BG value shown in overview
